question: Why are all the scriptures self-luminous in reality?
premises: All the scriptures do not fall away from the form of consciousness.
What does not fall away from self-luminous consciousness shares that luminosity.
inference: Because all scriptures remain within the form of self-luminous consciousness, they are in reality self-luminous.
plain_english: Therefore all the scriptures, because they do not fall away from the form of consciousness and because consciousness is self-luminous, are in reality self-luminous.
